QuestInfo.name: Blake's Dream
QuestInfo.0: Jake, who works at the subway station at the center of Kerning City has something on his mind.\r\nHead over to #bJake#k and see what's going on.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: Jake says he wants nothing more than to see Blake achieve his dream. Who's Blake anyway?\r\nPass through the turnstile and go over to Kerning Square Station.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: Blake has asked you to wait, as he was in the middle of something.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,500\nCan proceed to the My Dream Is to...quest \n

0.0: *sigh* It's too bad. It's just too bad. Do you want to know what's too bad?

yes.0: I have a coworker named Blake who has a dream that can easily come true with a little bit of help. He definitely has the talent, but I'm on duty and I can't just leave to help him, you know?
yes.1: Will you please go see Blake and help him out? You'll run into #bBlake#k if you enter through the Kerning City Subway Turnstile and head over to #bKerning Square Station#k.

1.0: Please hold on. I'm already looking for someone's lost belonging. I'll be right with you in just a few.

npc.0: You'll run into #bBlake#k if you enter through the Kerning City Subway Turnstile and head over to #bKerning Square Station#k.
